notes.title: A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition officially released on June 27th (Thu)!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition, a compilation package exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ featuring A Street Cat's Tale, the original kitty adventure game telling of the lives of cats on the streets, and A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous, the sequel telling the various tales of lost pet kitty Cinnamon's journey through the streets, was released to the Nintendo Switch™ on June 27th (Thursday)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35648228/65c0cff8281b1528795080bae5d936813615c24d.jpg

Today, you can experience the heart-warming stories of cats, people, and the other animals you meet along the way!

《A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition》
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35648228/8fa9439a347cd80227b9e5b3671cd6e88c4cf8ed.png
※A Street Cat's Tale: NekoNeko Edition is a package exclusive to the Nintendo Switch™ console.
※You can find this package through various online and offline retailers.

In addition to this, a downloadable version of A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous is now available on the Nintendo Switch™, allowing players to enjoy the entire A Street Cat's Tale series on the Nintendo Switch™.

• My Nintendo Store 「A Street Cat's Tale」
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/a-street-cats-tale-switch/

• My Nintendo Store 「A Street Cat's Tale 2: Outside is Dangerous」
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/a-street-cats-tale-2-outside-is-dangerous-switch/

(You can also find this game in your regional Nintendo eShop.)

As always, thank you for your support as we continue to work our hardest to bring you the best games.

Thank you.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.1.9 Update
notes.content:
Updated to version 1.1.9 after various bug fixes.

Additional features: 
You can now Run with using using the SHIFT button on your keyboard. (R2 on controllers)
*Beware though, Cinnamon's hunger wears off quickly when running!


bug detail :
-Fixed an issue where some car lights would not turn off in the morning. 
-Fixed lights turning on/off naturally over time. 
-Fixed incorrect layer order for some of the art graphics. 
-Fixed some camera positions in the ending scene.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.1.8 Update
notes.content:
Updated to version 1.1.8 after various bug fixes.


bug detail :

-Fixed an issue where light changes over time didn't look natural.
-Fixed an issue with the path of NPCs over time.
-Fixed some enemies' paths to not overlap with NPCs.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] Mac OS support & 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Mac OS support, and Other Bugs Resolved in the 1.0.3 Update.


Bug Details:

-Fixed screen jittering issue.
-Fixed an issue where the screen would cut off when changing resolutions. 
-Fixed an issue where cars would intermittently become transparent or overlap.
-Fixed an issue where sound effects could be heard in cutscenes even if the master sound setting was set to 0.
-Fixed an issue where the UI would not update correctly after a decrease in favorability.
-Fixed an issue with the NPC speech bubble UI not refreshing properly.
-Fixed an issue where the UI would not update properly during the combat tutorial. 
-Stealing is now available starting from Chapter 5.
-Adjusted the difficulty of some stealing contents.


**A street cat's tale 2 is now available from Mac OS.
please leave us comments or discussion if you found any bugs from the game. 
Thank you.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Unfixed Achievement Issues and Other Bugs Resolved in the 1.0.2 Update.



Bug Details:

-Fixed an issue where shortcuts related achievements were not being achieved.

-Fixed an issue where unlocking related  achievements were not being achieved.

-Fixed the issue where upgrade-related achievements were not being achieved.

-Fixed the issue intermittent walking animation not being displayed after cutscenes.

-Fixed the issue NPC UI update was not working properly in affection achievement quests.


Mac OS download unavailable.
The beta version of Mac OS was mistakenly made public for a short period of time. After sufficient testing on Mac-based devices, it will be supported again in the future. For users who accidentally purchased it, please request a refund or wait for the update. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.0.0.16 Update
notes.content:
A bug where the screen freezes when viewing the ending after completing the game and a bug where the game freezes in the pop-up state have been fixed, 


Bug Fixes:


-Resolved the issue of screen freezing during the ending.

-Resolved the problem of the game freezing when tutorials or other pop-ups appeared.

-Fixed the issue where quest items were infinitely obtained.

-Fixed the problem where the sound settings would reset to default when returning to the menu after 
adjusting them.

-Corrected typos.

notes.title: [A Street Cat's Tale 2] 1.0.0.14 Update
notes.content:
There was a bug in the previous version of the game that prevented the complete retrieval of save data. This bug has been fixed in the 1.0.0.14 version.



Bug details:

-Issue with store unlocking, upgrades, and tutorial being reset.

-Issue with the previous save file's progress being lost after reaching an ending.



Note: If you had unlocked any stores, upgraded from Jimmy, or completed any endings in the play data of versions prior to 1.0.0.14, there might have been data corruption. To ensure normal operation, please proceed with unlocking, upgrading, and completing endings again within the save file starting from version 1.0.0.14 onwards.
